$comment: Written by npm run schemas from core/schema. Change the definition there, not this file.
title: A drift record
description: Vendor data that differs from XenoNet's schema for it: a new or missing field, a field of another type, a new variant, a new version, or a line that isn't JSON.

source.description: <vendor>/<product>/<source>, the vendor schema's path without vendor/: anthropic/claude-code/transcript-line

vendorVersion.description: The version of the vendor's app that wrote the data, if it says

path.description: Where in the record: message.content[].citations; null where there's no field, as for a line that isn't JSON

variant.description: The kind of record it's in: the values of the discriminators around it, outermost first, such as ["assistant", "text"] for a text block in a reply; only values the schema lists. Left out where there's none

shape.description: Types only, at most four levels deep: object keys and their value types, array element types. Never a value, except a declared discriminator's (a line's type) and vendor versions
